## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Motivation

What problem would this feature solve, or why would it be useful?

Describe the use case or situation where you would use this feature.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature could work.

If applicable, include examples, sketches, screenshots, or references that help explain your idea.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing features you have considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, ideas, screenshots, or references related to the feature request.
